title: Creating an Etsy Shop
subtitle: Buyer account first, then seller, then lock it down

items.label: Step 1
items.title: Buyer account
items.text: Sign up at etsy.com with a direct email, not "Continue with Google".

items.label: Step 2
items.title: Sell on Etsy
items.text: Country: Pakistan. Currency: USD. Pakistan even if Etsy is not in your country.

items.label: Step 3
items.title: Name the shop
items.text: Unique, never your real name: niche, general or brand-specific.

items.label: Step 4
items.title: Secure it
items.text: "Keep your shop extra safe" with Google Authenticator, not SMS.

sections.quote: Next: advanced keyword research for the shop.
sections.text: Getting it right from the start avoids problems with the shop later.

title: RankKW: The Etsy SEO Tool and Shop Criteria
subtitle: Judge the first 10 listings before you commit to a shop

items.title: Sale colour
items.text: Green rising, red falling, any other colour stable.

items.title: Revenue
items.text: After Etsy's commission and tax are cut out.

items.title: Conversion rate
items.text: At least 3% minimum.

sections.heading: Assignment
items: Pick a keyword: top 10 listings none older than 3 months, 50+ sales each
